profile.name: USB4000光谱仪
profile.description: Ocean Optics USB4000 是一款通过 USB 控制的实验室光谱仪，可设置积分时间、配置触发方式、采集光谱，并查询温度、固件版本和设备状态，常用于光谱测量与光学表征。
profile.description_en: The Ocean Optics USB4000 is a USB-controlled laboratory spectrometer used to set integration time, configure trigger modes, acquire spectra, and query temperature, firmware version, and device status for spectroscopy and optical characterization.
